0022600162.text: The Wizards (3-3, on a W1 streak and 1-2 on the road) are 6th in the East and 1st in the Southeast, while the Orlando Magic (2-3, on a W1 streak and 0-2 at home) sit 9th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, 0.5 games back. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (out, foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip pinched nerve), and Alex Sarr and Anthony Gill are day-to-day with knee soreness and back spasms, respectively. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. In 2025-26 the Wizards lost the season series 1-3, including a 136-131 loss in Orlando on March 12, 2026.
